chapter_summary: Appendix C is a two-page results table of 68 historical trades (four anonymized systems A-D) giving position value, initial dollar risk, account net liquidation value, net P&L, P&L as a multiple of initial risk, P&L as a percent of position value, and a pro forma P&L column. It supplies the raw numbers for the statistical-significance and control-chart discussion in Chapter 13 and contains no OHLCV bar data or bar-level trading conditions, so it produced zero mineable candidates; both rejected entries record that nothing was silently skipped.
